Name: Map Teleport For 1.6 (SVE Compatible)
Author: chiccenSDV
Description:
Map Teleport is a mod originally by aedenthorn. I did write this from the ground up, but the original inspiration and some initial guidance on where to start stemmed from diving through their original Github repo. As such, this page will reference the original as a regular mod update. If you encounter issues, disable the mod and please post a bug report. A full log of the changes from the original mod are available upon request, but the spark notes will also be listed in the changelog. The source code is also available on [url=https://github.com/chiccenFL/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/MapTeleport]my Github.[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IsDoraN.gif[/img]

[color=#ffe599][size=4][b][u]DESCRIPTION[/u][/b][/size][/color]

This mod lets you teleport to any location on the map that has a tooltip by clicking on it.
There is also support to add any modded locations as you see fit, or modify existing location information.

The default configuration is:

[code]﻿EnableMod = true
AllowUnknown = false
EnableAudio = true
Debug = false
[/code]

You can edit the config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the mod's config.json file after starting the game once.
By default, you can only teleport to a location if you have visited the location and/or have met the NPC correlated with the location (e.g. you must meet Lewis to teleport to the Mayor's house). To change this, change [font=Courier New][color=#fce5cd]AllowUnknown[/color][/font] in config.json to [font=Courier New][color=#fce5cd]true[/color][/font], or tick the box using Generic Mod Config Menu.

If you would like support added for a mod, please make a comment in the "Posts" tab, or ﻿review the steps below on how to use the built-in SMAPI commands.

[color=#ffe599][size=4][b][u]SMAPI COMMANDS[/u][/b][/size][/color]
Map Teleport comes with a few extra SMAPI commands to help you customize and use the mod how you wish. Below I will detail the different commands and how they are used. I often use these commands myself when adding new locations or troubleshooting!
You can also view [url=https://youtu.be/LNVyHpGagqg]this YouTube video[/url] on how to utilize the built-in commands.

[font=Courier New][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b]mtp_edit[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[u]Paramters[/u]:
[list]
[*]string key (optional)
[*]int x (optional)
[*]int y﻿ (optional)
[/list][u]Syntax[/u]:
[code]﻿mtp_edit
mtp_edit key x y
[/code][u]Description[/u]: This command allows you to edit a teleport location. The primary function is to update the x/y coordinates once a location is added to the list of teleports. [color=#ea9999]Please note: this command also updates the region of the teleport to whichever region you are currently in in-game.[/color] This can be dangerous as many teleports can be seen on the map while in an adjacent region. For example: the farm, Pierre's Store, the mines, and the bathhouse can all be seen from the same map despite each of those locations being in a different map region (namely [color=#b6d7a8][b]Farm[/b]/Default[/color], [color=#a4c2f4][b]Town[/b]/PierreStore[/color], [color=#f9cb9c][b]Mountain[/b]/Mines[/color], and [color=#d5a6bd][b]RailRoad[/b]/Spa[/color]). This command can also be simplified by omitting the parameters (i.e. just type [font=Courier New][color=#a4c2f4]mtp_edit[/color][/font] with nothing following it and then press Enter) and Map Teleport will automatically assume you wish to update the last location you attempted to teleport to with your current region and your current x and y coordinates. For example, you can click on the community center, teleport there, and then walk to a different spot (or even inside the community center, if you'd prefer to just teleport inside) and then type [font=Courier New][color=#a4c2f4]mtp_edit[/color][/font] into the SMAPI console.
[u]Example[/u]:
[code]﻿mtp_edit SunberryVillage_Mountain/SilasBlacksmith 16 23[/code]

[font=Courier New][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b]mtp_save
[/b][/size][/color][/font][u]Parameters[/u]: None
[u]Syntax[/u]:
[code]mtp_save
[/code][u]Description[/u]: Saves any local changes to the list of locations (including any updates made with mtp_edit or new locations added) to the master JSON file that stores all teleport locations between play sessions.
[u]Example[/u]: see "Syntax"

[font=Courier New][color=#a4c2f4][size=4][b]mtp_load[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[u]Parameters[/u]: None
[u]Syntax[/u]:
[code]mtp_load
[/code][u]Description[/u]: Loads the list of locations from the master JSON file, overwriting any local changes. Useful for when you've edited the JSON file directly during a session, or if you'd like to undo any local changes to the teleport list. [color=#ea9999]Please note: as said, running this command will overwrite any local changes you've made if you haven't already saved them.[/color] Use at your own risk.
[u]Example[/u]: see "Syntax"

[size=5]Technical[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

[color=#dd7e6b]Original 1.5[/color] Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url] (uploader note: this is the original source code, not including any changes I made).

[color=#ffe599]Updated 1.6[/color] Code is at [url=https://github.com/chiccendev/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/MapTeleport]https://github.com/chiccendev/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/MapTeleport[/url]
